lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # Issue tracker: GitHub

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Issues and PRDs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Conventions

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title "..." --body "..."`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body "..."`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label "..."` / `--remove-label "..."`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment "..."`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Infer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Pull requests as a triage surface

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **PRs as a request surface: no.** Set this to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: When set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: GitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either; resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## When a skill says "publish to the issue tracker"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Create a GitHub issue.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## When a skill says "fetch the relevant ticket"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Run `gh issue view <number> --comments`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Wayfinding operations

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Used by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues are not enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Blocking**: GitHub's native issue dependencies are the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric database id (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, not the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies are not available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`; the session's first write.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body "<answer>"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.
